_doc: Box-score expected score (fitted Oct 25, 2026 on Weeks 1-7; coefficients are FIXED - applied as-is to new games). xPts = max(0, intercept + drives*b_drives + drives*availYardsPct/100*b_drivesXavail + drives*successRate/100*b_drivesXsuccess + drives*explosiveRate/100*b_drivesXexpl (CFB only) + (ints + 0.5*fumbleEvents)*b_expGiveaways), rounded to 0.1. Inputs from each team's box score: drives.total, drives.availYardsPct (missing -> 0), overall.successRate, overall.explosiveRate, turnovers.ints, turnovers.fumbleEvents (all fumbles, lost or not). xWin = round(100/(1+exp(-winSlope*(xPts - opp xPts)))) using the rounded xPts.
